svg.text: Cleans up a messy folder using an LLM. One Go binary, nothing to install
alongside it. It walks the directory, hashes every file with SHA-256, asks an
OpenAI compatible or local Ollama endpoint where things should go, and shows
you the moves in a Bubble Tea diff. Nothing is touched until you say yes, and
there is a dry run if you would rather just look. Every session goes into a
JSON history file, so any run can be undone.
